findings.body: The previously reported gap remains: seen IDs accumulate indefinitely, and session.end never deletes their keys. Each session also copies historical run-end IDs exposed by src/forge/board.py:289–300. Claude's [pinned store contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-code/684800b206824dfd0cc8a876e8604b20f72c3617/mods/types/claude-code.d.ts) rejects writes exceeding 4 MiB across the store. Once full, this write fails after successful submission, leaving the batch unacknowledged and causing repeated submissions on subsequent refreshes; new-session baselines also fail. Bound retained history and obsolete session keys while preserving occurrence deduplication.
findings.title: Bound persisted seen history before Claude's store limit

findings.body: The previous routing gap remains. forge.toml:6 and .github/workflows/forge-next.yml:58 run pytest, while tests/test_mod_plugin.py:45–57 only typechecks the native tests. The packaged case exercises real occurrences and reload batching, but failed-submit retries, worker/headless gating and session resets still depend on native assertions the automated suite does not execute. plans/FORGE-MOD-1.md:284 assigns the plugin CI job to SHIP; that task must route these tests into CI.
findings.title: Later: SHIP must run the native event tests in CI
